alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: User: <ARN_1> is not authorized to perform

root_cause.hypothesis: Alarm likely tripped on near-zero CPU utilization (0.0056%) despite task_running=task_desired=2 and no failed deployments — pattern fits app-level stall/hang or traffic-loss (e.g. LB misroute, dependency block) rather than crash/OOM, since memory is normal (~59%) and no scaling/pending/failure signals present. In-flight deployment could be incidental or the trigger (e.g. new task not yet serving), but deployments_failed=0 and no recent deploy history weakens that link.
evidence: cpu_utilization_pct ~0.0056% — abnormally low for active service
tasks_running == tasks_desired (2/2), tasks_pending 0 — no capacity/scheduling issue
memory_utilization_pct ~58.6% — normal, argues against OOM/crash loop
LOGS field empty — no corroborating log evidence
ruled_out: Task scheduling failure / capacity shortage (running==desired, no pending)

proposal.reasoning: CPU near-zero but tasks_running=desired=2, memory normal, deployments_failed=0, no logs captured. Pattern fits traffic-loss/stall (LB misroute, dependency block) but evidence too thin to pick a remediation confidently, and an in-flight deployment is active — restarting or rolling back now could collide with it. No crash/OOM/scale signal to justify an automated fix.
proposal.expected_effect: On-call reviews checkout LB target health, dependency connectivity, and in-flight deployment status before any action taken; avoids blind restart/rollback during active deploy.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
